name: Osten (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided green over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Osten (blue wavy bars and a red eagle on white).
history: Municipal flag of Osten; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Osten arms — wavy bars and eagle
